integrity: Universal claim is proved analytically in RESULT.md. Standalone exact and numerical LP/spectral checks are supplementary. Prior wheel spectral theory is credited explicitly; no independent mathematical validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The result optimizes SLEM for symmetric stochastic wheel kernels with a uniform minimum on every rim transition, for m>=4 and 0<=tau<=1/2. It does not address nonreversible chains, nonuniform equilibria or finite-time mixing. The unconstrained wheel spectrum and unconstrained optimum are prior work. Global optimizer uniqueness beyond the dihedral-invariant subclass is not asserted. Literature coverage remains nonexhaustive.
title: A four-phase constrained fastest-mixing law for wheel networks
